yahoo.raw_close_definition: Unadjusted daily Close returned by the provider; adjusted close retained separately for audit only.

vix_proxy.source: Yahoo Finance chart API ^VIX daily Close
vix_proxy.note: Broad S&P 500 implied volatility proxy only; not QQQ IV or QQQ put skew. Missing days are not forward-filled.

vxn_proxy.source: Yahoo Finance chart API ^VXN daily Close
vxn_proxy.note: Nasdaq-100 implied-volatility index proxy; not a QQQ option IV/skew surface and not executable option data. Missing days are not forward-filled.

current_tape_observations.interpretation: Observed price path only; neither an option-strategy loss estimate nor a tradable signal.

limitations: The Yahoo price series is a separately fetched vendor proxy, not the pinned option-source's underlying field.
VIXCLS, when available, is broad S&P 500 implied volatility; it is not QQQ IV or a QQQ put-skew surface.
Post-2025-12-15 probabilities describe QQQ prices only. No option-chain outcomes, bid/ask marks, fills, margin, or assignments are inferred.
Historical windows overlap; Wilson intervals are nominal and do not remove serial dependence.
2018-2025 remains development/revisit history, not a blind holdout.
